full_judgment: 92. Even the Government Manual says "hats and markets may be established in Government estates where there is demand for these to suit the convenience of Khas Mahal tenants. When there are suitable hats in existence for a long time in the neighbourhood, there is no need to establish a new one in the Khas Mahal."
